title: harness: skill-delete-guard (skill delete forbidden, use archive)
desc: Blocks 'wkappbot skill delete' commands. Skills must be archived, not deleted, to preserve knowledge history.
steps: SAFETY: Catches 'wkappbot skill delete <id>' commands. Deletion permanently removes skill knowledge, breaking any CLAUDE.md or harness references to that skill and losing the accumulated steps.
SOLUTION: Use 'wkappbot skill archive <id>' instead of delete. Archive preserves the content, removes it from active search results, and keeps history intact for future reference.
PREVENTION: Never run 'wkappbot skill delete'. If a skill is wrong, edit it (wkappbot skill edit). If it is obsolete, archive it. Deletion is forbidden -- there is no undo.
author: claude
